description: Poland MSiG Court Gazette Scraper. Search Polish Court & Economic Gazette (Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy) for bankruptcy declarations, liquidation notices, restructuring proceedings, creditor calls. Full-text search across archive from 2001. Structured JSON output. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

dateFrom.description: Start of the publication date range. Required by the gazette - a search without both dates is rejected. Pick a date, or type a relative one such as "3 months".
dateFrom.title: Published from

dateTo.description: End of the publication date range. Required by the gazette - a search without both dates is rejected. Pick a date, or type a relative one such as "1 week".
dateTo.title: Published to

fetchDetails.description: Fetch full announcement details (body text) for each result. Slower but returns complete content. If false, returns only list data (no body text).
fetchDetails.title: Fetch Full Details

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of announcements to return. Set to 0 for every match. Starts at 10 so a first run is cheap to try - raise it once the search looks right.
maxResults.title: Max Results

monitorKey.description: Just a label for your watchlist history, not a password or API key - it is shown masked. Optional name for this monitor's memory, e.g. 'client-acme'. Leave empty and the search itself is the name.
monitorKey.title: Monitor name (optional)

onlyNew.description: For scheduled checks of the same company or search. The first run returns every matching notice and remembers it; every later run of the SAME search returns only notices published since, each with changeType 'new'. Gazette notices never change once published, so nothing is reported as changed. A run with nothing new succeeds with an empty dataset and a status message. Use a rolling window such as Published from '1 month' and Published to '0 days' - the dates are not part of the memory. Set Max results to 0 so the first run records every match. The memory is kept in your own Apify account (a key-value store named regdata-msig-monitor); delete it to start again.
onlyNew.title: Monitor mode - only new notices

searchType.description: A = Announcements database (bankruptcy, liquidation, restructuring, court notices). B = KRS entries database (company registrations, changes — being phased out since Nov 2025).
searchType.title: Search Type

textInBody.description: Full-text search inside the announcement body (max 1000 chars). MATCHES LITERALLY, SO POLISH DIACRITICS ARE REQUIRED: "upadłości" returns hundreds of notices a month, "upadlosci" returns none. Case does not matter and phrases work. Try: upadłości, likwidacji, wierzycieli, syndyk, restrukturyzacji.
textInBody.title: Text in Body

textInPosition.description: Search the announcement header line - the "Poz. NNNNN. NAME. KRS ... COURT ..." summary (max 1000 chars). Same literal matching as Text in Body, so Polish diacritics are required. Try: LIKWIDACJI, REJONOWY, GOSPODARCZY.
textInPosition.title: Text in Position

name: regdata_msig
